# Ajax Heating & Cooling

> Ajax Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Ajax, Durham Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (905) 619-3742  |  Email: contact@ajaxheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ajaxheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
